diplomacy: Cyhluven declared a war on its rival Dird
Dird's ally Sheoralon joined the war on defenders side
Dird's ally Brirongbia joined the war on defenders side
Cyhluven's ally Aethethana avoided entering the war
Cyhluven's ally Lideria avoided entering the war
Mythtafet declared a war on its rival Sheoralon
Mythtafet's vassal Seranarion joined the war on attackers side
Mythtafet's vassal Ilelmalas joined the war on attackers side
Mythtafet's vassal Inonebele joined the war on attackers side
Frightened by Mythtafet, Lideria severed the defense pact with Sheoralon
Sheoralon's ally Dird joined the war on defenders side
Mythtafet's ally Fayhostle joined the war on attackers side
Fayhostle's vassal Oxbreak joined the war on attackers side
Mythtafet's ally Kanlean joined the war on attackers side
Enathond declared a war on its rival Thorngelia
Being already at war, Kanlean severed the defense pact with Thorngelia
Anwel declared a war on its rival Thorngelia
Anwel's ally Aethethana joined the war on attackers side
Yhanar declared a war on its rival Enathond
Yhanar's ally Noranen joined the war on attackers side
